title: Time-resolved correlation engineering in DLCZ Raman photon sources
summary: Memory-assisted quantum networks require photon sources with controllable temporal and correlation properties. The Duan-Lukin-Cirac-Zoller (DLCZ) protocol provides a platform based on spontaneous Raman scattering in atomic ensembles, but a unified predictive theory connecting control parameters to correlations under realistic propagation and noise conditions remains lacking. Here we present a propagation-inclusive open-system quantum theory that retains write-induced population redistribution while combining Heisenberg-Langevin dynamics with Maxwell-Schrödinger propagation.
